verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments platform that holds user identity and wallet data, so data retention and deletion is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no retention settings, data-deletion requests, or export/erase controls. Account deactivation only stops new token creation and leaves in-flight tokens chargeable, and selective disclosure of identity fields in tokens is an adjacent data-minimization feature. Neither counts as user control over retention or deletion.
